title: Nightmare Shift
about: Pick up passengers who aren’t quite human. Learn each night’s rules, watch for deadly tells, manage your fuel, and survive until dawn.

controls.desc: Decline ride offer; tap the visible Decline button
Use every visible button; no keyboard required

extra_sections.heading: Instructions
extra_sections.body:
• Observe Passengers: Watch for "tells" that indicate dangerous entities.
  • Follow Guidelines: Consult your rulebook and make life-or-death decisions.
  • Manage Resources: Earnings buy fuel and upgrades. Don't run dry.
